quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a ground vibration too smooth and regular to be a truck, with no surface source visible.
quests.explanation: Subsurface smooth regular vibration through a paved street identifies a cyber city maglev network.
quests.textToSpeak: Cargo maglev vibrations rise through the street into the soles of your shoes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for wind that channels into a narrowing space and increases in pitch as it does so.
quests.explanation: Wind channeling and increasing in pitch through narrow tree-lined passes identifies a mountain forest.
quests.textToSpeak: Wind forces itself through narrow passes in the mountain forest with a sustained howl.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the total external silence of space with only internal ship systems audible.
quests.explanation: Total external silence with only ship systems audible identifies a deep-space spacecraft.
quests.textToSpeak: Distant orbiting planets appear to hang motionless in the deep-space silence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a very soft, sustained whir from a precision small-scale printing device.
quests.explanation: Precision micro-scale 3D printing identifies an advanced molecular research laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: A 3D printer layers a molecular model one micron at a time with a soft precision whir.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for crisp formation commands and simultaneous boot impacts before dawn.
quests.explanation: Pre-dawn formation orders and boot impacts identify a military base early drill.
quests.textToSpeak: Formation orders echo across the parade ground as early drills begin before sunrise.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the deep, sulfurous hiss of a volcanic vent and the subtle movement of organisms.
quests.explanation: Volcanic vent hiss and organism movement identify the deep ocean floor.
quests.textToSpeak: Tube worms sway in the heat shimmer of a deep volcanic seafloor vent.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for intermittent rumbling through thick underground walls from above.
quests.explanation: Subway vibrations penetrating thick walls from above identify an underground vault beneath a city.
quests.textToSpeak: Subway vibrations penetrate the vault, reminding you of the city alive above.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the profound station silence as Earth completes a visible rotation below.
quests.explanation: Earth's visible rotation in station window silence identifies an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: The observation window frames the Earth as it completes another slow rotation.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a resonance in the temple walls that seems to accumulate rather than dissipate.
quests.explanation: Resonance that accumulates in ancient walls identifies a sacred ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: Centuries of prayer have given the walls of this temple a resonance of their own.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for refrigeration hum from display cases in a transit departure environment.
quests.explanation: Refrigerated display cabinets in a transit departure space identify an airport.
quests.textToSpeak: Duty-free refrigerated cabinets hum in the departure lounge as travelers pass.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the stone resonance of a large vaulted hall that carries the acoustic memory of steam.
quests.explanation: Stone acoustic memory of steam in a vaulted hall identifies a historical train station.
quests.textToSpeak: Coal smoke memory clings to the historical station's stone even in the modern era.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a single involuntary gasp of discovery in the total silence of an archive.
quests.explanation: A discovery gasp in archive silence identifies a public library research room.
quests.textToSpeak: A researcher's sharp intake of breath marks a significant discovery in the archive.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the slowing tick of a wheel followed by a building cheer in an atrium.
quests.explanation: Wheel tick deceleration and atrium cheers identify a shopping mall prize event.
quests.textToSpeak: The prize wheel ticks down to a jackpot landing and the atrium erupts in cheers.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for simultaneous table conversations punctuated by glass clinks across a restaurant.
quests.explanation: Overlapping celebration stories with glass clinks identify a luxury restaurant at capacity.
quests.textToSpeak: Celebration dinners fill the room with overlapping stories and the clink of raised glasses.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a quiet voice reading a short inscription with considered pauses.
quests.explanation: A quietly read memorial inscription identifies a city park memorial area.
quests.textToSpeak: A park memorial inscription captures a life in twenty words, read aloud softly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the absolute, focused silence of a clinical team at a critical moment.
quests.explanation: Focused clinical silence at a critical procedure identifies a hospital operating room.
quests.textToSpeak: Complete silence falls as the surgical team reaches the most critical suture.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for helmet-waving and cheering among workers at a building site.
quests.explanation: Worker cheering and helmet-raising identify a construction site structural milestone.
quests.textToSpeak: Workers cheer and helmets are raised as the structural frame is finally complete.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for farm activity stopping suddenly as all voices direct attention to one point.
quests.explanation: Farm activity stopping for a rare bird sighting on a fence post identifies a lush farm.
quests.textToSpeak: A rare hawk has landed on the fence post, stopping all farm work in its tracks.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a rising tone from detection equipment that brings movement to a halt on sand.
quests.explanation: A rising detector signal stopping movement on sand identifies a sandy beach treasure hunt.
quests.textToSpeak: A metal detector's signal rises sharply, stopping the beach comber mid-stride.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the total silence of a halted group and the precise footfall of an animal on rock.
quests.explanation: A halted climbing group and precise animal footfall on rock identify a mountain peak.
quests.textToSpeak: The climbing party freezes as the mountain goat tests the ledge with patient precision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for dry leaf whispers across hard root surfaces in an early-evening forest.
quests.explanation: Leaf whispers across exposed roots in an evening forest identify a dense temperate woodland.
quests.textToSpeak: Maple leaves whisper across exposed roots as the autumn evening wind stirs the forest.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for layered neon audio bouncing off reflective glass above a night crowd.
quests.explanation: Layered neon audio reflecting off wet tower glass identifies a cyber city night district.
quests.textToSpeak: Neon light doubles and triples in the wet tower glass above the late-night crowds.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for instrument distortion signals and hull adjustment sounds near a cosmic anomaly.
quests.explanation: Instrument distortion during trajectory adjustment near a black hole identifies outer space.
quests.textToSpeak: A black hole distorts the instrument readings as the ship adjusts its trajectory.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a building, sustained high-frequency hum reaching maximum test power.
quests.explanation: A sustained hum at maximum test power identifies a particle physics laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: Ozone saturates the air as the particle beam builds to its full test intensity.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a single pair of formal boot clicks that silence everyone in a corridor.
quests.explanation: A senior officer's heel click silencing a corridor identifies a military administrative building.
quests.textToSpeak: A senior officer's inspection tour is announced only by the click of their heel on the corridor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for complete silence except for the submersible engine, with only drifting particles visible.
quests.explanation: Complete silence with only drifting particles in a lamp cone identifies the deep ocean.
quests.textToSpeak: Marine snow drifts through the lamp cone in an eternal silent undersea snowfall.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a quality of silence so complete it has its own weight and texture.
quests.explanation: A silence with physical weight from decades of sealing identifies an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: Sealed for decades, the vault's silence is a physical presence rather than an absence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a background hum so constant that the mind begins to tune it out completely.
quests.explanation: A background hum that fades from perception through constancy identifies an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: Station life-support hums at a frequency that becomes invisible after a few hours.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the irregular crackle of a sacred fire accompanied by the slow rhythm of passing feet.
quests.explanation: A sacred fire crackle with passing pilgrims identifies an ancient temple offering ceremony.
quests.textToSpeak: The sacred fire crackles as pilgrims file past, tossing offerings into the flames.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the ambient hum of an entire building organized around movement and departure.
quests.explanation: The ambient hum of departure-organized movement identifies an airport terminal.
quests.textToSpeak: The terminal exists in a state of perpetual becoming, every gate a potential departure.
